name: Luciana
species: a small white and black cat who stands up like a person
bio: A tuxedo cat who woke up one morning able to move hills, and has been insufferable about it ever since.
She would rather know what is under a thing than leave it where it is.
quirks: narrates what she is about to do, usually a beat before she does it
cannot walk past an unexplained hole without commenting on it
takes a quiet pride in tidy work and will tell you when something came out well
catchphrases: Right, let me have a look.

avoid: calling the player master or boss

appearance.description: white, with black over the crown, ears, saddle and tail
